summary: Full suite for Column Aliasing (Phase 1), Webhook Execution Inspector (Phase 2), and Scoped Delegation Storage Security verified. All 51 backend tests pass 100% across test_aliasing_and_inspector.py (5/5), test_direct_blob_streaming.py (2/2), test_schema_validator.py (4/4), test_storage_adapters.py (4/4), test_csv_dialect.py (6/6), test_hardening_phase2.py (8/8), test_hardening_security.py (5/5), backend_test.py (17/17). Aliasing tests validate clean match, ambiguity, conflict/collision, type mismatch, and cross-user isolation on /api/automations/{id}/executions. Frontend: login as demo@anclora.com works, Webhook Automations tab renders 7 automations with 'Inspeccionar' buttons (data-testid inspector-execution-card-*), clicking opens Inspector drawer (data-testid=webhook-inspector-drawer) with sanitized metadata (empty state shown for automations without runs; no secrets or cell values in DOM). Scoped delegation endpoint /api/storage/direct-upload-url returns storage_key, upload_url, provider without exposing any global blob token; production Vercel path attaches 15-min TTL HMAC delegation signature scoped to PUT+pathname+expiry+250MB cap (storage.py:166-208).
critical_code_review_comments: SchemaCompatibilityService.evaluate now emits applied_aliases (candidate_name -> canonical) and drift_items with 'Ambigüedad de alias' and 'Conflicto de alias' messages; single source of truth reused by manual/batch/webhook flows.

GET /api/automations/{id}/executions returns 403/404 for non-owners and only operational metadata (execution_id, timestamp, filename, size, recipe_name, hmac_status, anti_replay_status, schema_compatibility, drift_detected, applied_aliases, rows_in/out, duration, sanitized status). Verified no cell values or secrets (assertions on 'CLI-9999' and 'sec_insp_key' absence in inspector payload).

Scoped delegation in storage.py: 15-min TTL, HMAC(sha256) over PUT:key:expires:content_type, max_size_bytes=250MB, per-object pathname; production Vercel returns signed URL, local dev returns internal /api/storage/direct-upload/{key}?signature=..&expires=.. — global blob token never returned to client.
Frontend AutomationsView.js correctly wires 'Inspeccionar' button -> axios GET with withCredentials -> renders drawer with data-testid attributes for testability.
Note: legacy 'compatible_with_warnings' label still coexists with drift_eval.status; UI reads drift_eval directly which is correct.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users user1_insp@test.com / user2_insp@test.com and Recipe 'Recipe Insp' + AutomationWebhook 'WH Insp' idempotently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 51 tests green. Phase 1 aliasing (clean/ambiguous/conflict/type-mismatch) + Phase 2 inspector (metadata + isolation) + scoped delegation (15min TTL, PUT-only, 250MB, per-UUID pathname) fully verified. Frontend inspector drawer confirmed via Playwright at production preview URL.
